ezekiel.34.p1.b1.text: Woe to the shepherds of Israel, who only feed themselves! Should not the shepherds feed their flock?

ezekiel.34.p1.b2.text: You eat the fat, wear the wool, and butcher the fattened sheep, but you do not feed the flock.

ezekiel.34.p1.b3.text: You have not … healed the sick, bound up the injured

ezekiel.34.p1.b4.text: My flock went astray on all the mountains and every high hill. … with no one to search for them or seek them out.

ezekiel.34.p1.b5.text: Behold, I Myself will search for My flock and seek them out.

ezekiel.34.p1.b6.text: I will rescue them from all the places to which they were scattered on a day of clouds and darkness.

ezekiel.34.p1.b7.text: I will seek the lost, bring back the strays, bind up the broken, and strengthen the weak

ezekiel.34.p2.b1.text: Is it not enough for you to drink the clear waters? Must you also muddy the rest with your feet?

ezekiel.34.p2.b2.text: Behold, I Myself will judge between the fat sheep and the lean sheep.

ezekiel.34.p2.b3.text: I will appoint over them one shepherd, My servant David, and he will feed them. He will feed them and be their shepherd.

ezekiel.34.p2.b4.text: I will send down showers in season—showers of blessing.

ezekiel.34.p2.b5.text: I have broken the bars of their yoke

ezekiel.34.p2.b6.text: You are My flock, the sheep of My pasture, My people, and I am your God
